profile.status: Supplied guideline excerpts and spatial inspiration indexed
profile.basis: 15 supplied Sleepyhead screenshots; 100 Pinterest board entries with 102 saved still images/thumbnails and source-linked assistant analysis. Original guideline version/approval not established.

sections.title: Identity and personality
sections.summary: Human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky, fabulous. Jester: connection and enjoyment; humorous, informal, creative, personable.

sections.title: Visual identity
sections.summary: Orange #F15A22, charcoal #414042; white RGB implies #FFFFFF but printed #231F20 conflicts. Migrena Grotesque; Source Sans Pro for web. Authentic wordmark and ee monogram; logo/font originals absent.

sections.title: Spatial world
sections.summary: Whole-room inspiration: architecture, room scale, circulation, colour zoning, materials, daylight, furniture relationships and lived-in activities. Bright apartments, pastel sculptural rooms, retro graphic homes, compact connected spaces, reading corners, playful bedrooms and quieter alternatives.

sections.title: Research coverage
sections.summary: 100 board entries accounted for; 102 rendered still images/thumbnails saved, including four carousel images. One video entry has no exposed still image. Videos were not downloaded, played or analysed. All 102 saved images inspected in six labelled contact sheets plus one full-size image; overview-level visual interpretation, not fine-detail/authenticity/material/licensing audit. Pinterest captions and alt text retained as unverified source descriptions. Screenshots S01–S15 inspected as supplied.

sourcePrecedence: Exact official Sleepyhead SKU/variant evidence governs product identity and claims.
Supplied Sleepyhead guideline excerpts govern identity, retaining version/approval uncertainty and recorded contradictions.
Explicit client scene-execution direction governs physical integration and real architectural copy space.
User-selected Pinterest spaces and assistant analysis are advisory scene inspiration, not product proof or mandatory brand rules.
Official website observations are current public evidence; distinguish them from supplied guidelines.

assets.name: Sleepyhead S14 guideline excerpt.png
assets.note: S14 | Supplied guideline screenshot excerpt; version and approval not established. Primary palette: Vermilion/Giants Orange RGB 241,90,34, HEX #F15A22, CMYK 0,80,100,0; playful/lively. Charcoal/Metal Grey RGB 65,64,66, HEX #414042, CMYK 0,0,0,90; neutraliser. Titanium/Classic White RGB 255,255,255 and CMYK 0,0,0,0, clean/airy dominant. ERROR: white is printed HEX #231F20, a dark colour; RGB implies #FFFFFF. Store both source values and mark #FFFFFF as an interpretation pending source correction. Do not use #231F20 as white. Printed Pantone values are source specifications only, not verified conversion or print proof.
assets.trainingNote: Actual image available as a visual reference in this brand’s next research refresh. Samples are not mandatory rules or product proof.

assets.name: Sleepyhead S09 guideline excerpt.png
assets.note: S09 | Supplied guideline screenshot excerpt; version and approval not established. Logo prohibitions: poor-contrast backgrounds, rotation, bevel/emboss, drop shadow, altered colours, busy photographs/patterns. Right-hand text suggests contrasting solid backgrounds, a slightly transparent patch, alternative variants and high contrast. Conflict: the client scene-execution policy prohibits artificial patches/haze/fades to rescue copy/logo contrast. In scenes use real wall/backdrop space or permitted text/logo treatment; preserve the source conflict instead of silently merging the rules.
assets.trainingNote: Actual image available as a visual reference in this brand’s next research refresh. Samples are not mandatory rules or product proof.
